question: Does a scale-free diagonal-metric regularisation that shrinks each coordinate's window variance toward the window's median variance beat the shipped DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan on the 17-model posteriordb screen, and is it safe on Neal's funnel?

sfmed.formula: (n/(n+5)) var_i + (5/(n+5)) * m, m = median_j var_j (mean of the two middle values for even dimension); anchor m := 1 if m is not finite and positive

sfstan.formula: (n/(n+5)) var_i + 1e-3 * (5/(n+5)) * m, same m and fallback

common: Tuning::default() (h0 0.5, depth 10, min_micro_steps 1, eight refinement levels, delta 1, MomentumSum, divergence threshold 1000); Metric::diagonal(); dual averaging 0.8 on CurrentCoarseEndpoint; DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION (AcceptUnlessDivergent in warmup); no chain rescue (DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = None); Init::uniform(); Limits::admit_worst_case(); four threads; scale-free arms through Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8).with_warmup_exhaustion_rule(DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION).with_metric_regularization(arm)), which is field-for-field what Adaptation::DualAveraging{0.8} builds except the regularisation
run_order: models in listed order; for each model arms in arms_order; for each arm seeds ascending; strictly sequential, one sampling process at a time; then the funnel side check arms in arms_order x seeds ascending
efficiency_statistic: per cell: minimum over posteriordb reference parameters of ArviZ bulk ESS divided by total target calls (warmup + retained); per model: median over the three seeds; per arm: geometric mean over the 17 models of (arm seed-median / da seed-median)
instrumentation: per chain: final installed mass diagonal, every slow-window metric update (window, transition, draw count, outcome, installed mass, step before); per cell: installed variance (1/mass) over the variance of the cell's retained unconstrained draws, per coordinate and chain

side_checks.funnel: copied from STUDIES/refinement_role_v1: Neal's 10-D funnel at the sampler defaults with the arm's regularisation, 4 chains x 2,000 warmup / 20,000 retained, starts omega in {-3, -1, 1, 3} (other coordinates 0), four threads, per-seed MCSE z of P(omega < -5) against the exact 0.0478 (diagnostics::mcse_mean of the indicator); gate |z| <= 2 on every seed; seeds = the study seeds; src/bin/funnel.rs

decision_rules_text: Recommend flipping sampler::DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION to a scale-free arm iff, for that arm: C1 geomean min-bulk-ESS/gradient ratio vs da over all 17 models >= 1.10; C2 no model's seed-median ratio < 0.85 (no carve-outs; a model with a missing ratio fails C1 and C2); C3 cells passing all gates >= da's; C4 funnel |z| <= 2 on all three seeds. If both arms qualify, the higher C1. Otherwise recommend keeping DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan; the scale-free variants stay opt-in. The study recommends; it does not change the default. Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results.
references_cited_not_rerun: CmdStan 2.39.0 seed medians from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v5 (seeds 87101-87103), context only

predictions.P1: sfmed (primary) geomean vs da 1.00 (90% interval 0.88-1.10): fails C1
predictions.P2: sfmed on kidiq 0.5x (0.3-0.8x): kidiq's unconstrained posterior variances are 34, 4.9, 0.0037, 0.0012, the even-dimension median is 2.46 and the 5/(n+5) weight installs 0.024 on the two small coordinates (predicted installed/posterior 7.6x and 22x, measured median over chains >= 5x on the smallest coordinate, against da ~1.0x); sfmed fails C2 on kidiq
predictions.P3: sblrc: the posteriordb reference variance of the five coefficients is ~1.0e-6, so Stan's 9.9e-6 prior installs ~11x the posterior variance (measured da installed/posterior >= 5x on the coefficients; WP27's 'CmdStan's 1.07e-5 inverse metric is the posterior variance' was the Stan-regularised value, not the posterior). Both scale-free arms install 0.8-1.3x. sblrc ratio vs da 2.5x (1.5-4x) for both arms, median final step >= 1.5x da's
predictions.P4: sfstan (secondary) geomean vs da 1.065 (0.98-1.15); P(C1 >= 1.10) ~0.3; every model's predicted max installed/posterior <= 1.01 so outside sblrc and diamonds the ratios are seed noise around 1 (kidiq, earnings, arma11, arK, nes2000 within 0.85-1.15x)
predictions.P5: diamonds: da installs up to 4.2x the posterior variance on one coordinate and 1.2-1.5x on fourteen; both scale-free arms ~1.0-1.1x; ratio vs da 1.1x (0.85-1.5x) for both arms (depth-capped either way)
predictions.P6: sfmed other models: nes2000 0.9x (0.75-1.05; 1.5x inflation on its 0.0011 coordinate), arK 0.9x (0.75-1.05; 1.4x), hmm_example 0.95x (0.8-1.1); remaining healthy models within 0.85-1.1x; the lottery / fail-everywhere cells (hmm_drive_0, lotka_volterra, centered eight schools, accel_gp, one_comp) may fall anywhere
predictions.P7: earnings keeps >= 2/3 gates under both scale-free arms and every coordinate installs within 0.5-2x of its posterior variance in every chain (no coordinate installed at the anchor alone: MomentumSum orbits measure every coordinate)
predictions.P8: funnel |z| <= 2 on every seed for all three arms
predictions.P9: cells passing: da 42 +- 4 of 51; sfmed da - 3 to da + 1 (kidiq may lose gates, sblrc cannot gain: already 3/3 in v5); sfstan within da +- 2
predictions.P10: no arm meets the rule (probability ~0.85); recommendation keep DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan; if an arm qualifies it is sfstan

prediction_input: predict_scales.py -> artifacts/prediction-scales.json: unconstrained posterior variances from the posteriordb reference draws and the variance each rule would install from an exactly measured n = 500 window (no sampler run; eight_schools_noncentered and gp_pois_regr skipped because their reference draws do not carry the unconstrained parameters)
